description: For any two partial recursive unary functions, a partial recursive function can return an output from either one and have domain exactly the union of their domains.
signature:
Nat.Partrec.merge' {f g : ℕ →. ℕ} (hf : Nat.Partrec f) (hg : Nat.Partrec g) :
  ∃ h, Nat.Partrec h ∧ ∀ (a : ℕ), (∀ x ∈ h a, x ∈ f a ∨ x ∈ g a) ∧ ((h a).Dom ↔ (f a).Dom ∨ (g a).Dom)
